Test Case Title: Verify Input Box 2 is hidden initially and can be shown and hidden with the toggle button
Preconditions: Browser is launched; 'Hidden Elements & AJAX' page is open
Test Steps: 1. Verify Input Box 2 is not visible 2. Click 'Toggle Input Box 2' 3. Verify it is visible and status says 'Input Box 2 shown' 4. Click the toggle again 5. Verify it is hidden and status says 'Input Box 2 hidden'
Expected Result: Visibility switches hidden -> shown -> hidden with matching status messages
